{{Quote|Here. Take food.|The Klatoonian crew member, to Ania Solo|<ref name="Legacy 12">[[Legacy (2013) 12|''Legacy'' (2013) 12]]</ref>}}
A [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] '''crew member''' served aboard the [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] [[Ramid]]'s starship in [[139 ABY]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the Klatoonian took part in the successful [[Kidnapping of Ania Solo|kidnapping]] of [[Ania Solo]], Ramid's estranged former lover who was wanted by the [[Galactic Federation Triumvirate]] for the alleged murder of the [[Imperial Knight]] [[Teemen Alton]].<ref name="Legacy 11" /> Later, the Klatoonian, who was not experienced in kidnapping, was sent to feed Solo some snacks. During that encounter, she overpowered the Klatoonian with a rod. Solo was later overpowered by Ramid and his [[Unidentified Twi'lek pilot|Twi'lek pilot]], who locked her back inside the storage locker. Later, Ramid's starship was pursued by [[Unidentified masked bounty hunter|another bounty hunter]], who piloted a [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bomber]]. During the pursuit, Ramid's starship sustained heavy damage and the Klatooinian was killed during a forced-landing.<ref name="Legacy 12" />
